summary: Frontend-only test of SOC Triage Desk (no backend). Tested the 14 requested feature groups with Playwright at 1920x1080 and 400px width, re-seeding localStorage before each run. All core flows work: seed data (INC-24131 shows Likely FP/Low with the Sample tag, 5 recent rows); the Sample A traffic table and report format (exact bytes line, '(mostly inbound)'); the RDP sample (TP/Critical, all 6 MITRE IDs, Partly blocked pill, email To/subject correct, IOCs defanged); escalate/undo (pill, SLA timer, Client comms note, entry appears in Notables); Clear, custom ticket, Ctrl+Enter generate and recent-row reload; Copy buttons switch to 'Copied' and back after ~2s; the context strip shows on every tab except Assessment and Change ticket works; Investigation (Paste/Ticket mode toggle, Load sample with green hint, all 7 languages change the query text, basis tags, 'Run with ·' footers, per-technique Hunt queries, checklist x of y, timeline with technique and Blocked badges, decoded PowerShell); OSINT (links open in _blank, verdict changes card border and tally, private IP and invalid input are rejected, a domain is added, verdicts flow into the email IOC list); SOC Notes (add, empty-note message, both insert buttons, delete, glance panel, Copy all, Backup .json download); Playbook (Northwind auto-selected, Low row highlighted, containment callout, matching procedure auto-opens, edit and save persist after reload, New client opens an empty editor); Notables (Jun 2 Morning has 3 escalations, Jun 1 Night has INC-24098, severity pills, status persists after reload, text copies); theme cycles system->light->dark->system and dark mode renders well; at 400px there is no page horizontal scroll and the tab bar scrolls (overflow-x auto); keys 1-6 switch tabs and are ignored inside inputs; Ctrl+Shift+C copies the report; mask toggle works; duplicate IOC warning works; report checklist and title-number mismatch warnings work. No console errors and no alert/confirm/prompt dialogs in any run. Only minor issues were found.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Undo escalated' does not remove the auto-added 'Client comms' note, so escalating again adds a duplicate note.
Generate on a completely empty form saves a junk ticket TKT-xxxxxx ('Untitled alert', Likely Benign) in Recent assessments. There is no validation that raw logs are present.
Masking replaces the client name, users, hosts and internal IPs, but the client email domain stays visible in the email (To: csirt@harborlane.example).

The hint is stale: after Load sample (detects Sentinel) and then pasting Fortigate logs + Suggest queries, it still says 'Detected Microsoft Sentinel logs'. The hint only updates when the detected language differs and is never cleared on a new paste.
'Last change: — 19:23' shows '—' as the author when the header analyst identity is empty. It should fall back to entry.form.analyst.

issues: The note time field uses the browser's native datetime-local picker, not a styled or shadcn date-time picker.
The clipboard fallback leaves the whole <pre> block highlighted after copying (seen in headless). Clear the selection after copying.
The NFA/false-positive notification email still uses the subject '[LOW] Security Incident Escalation – ...', which is misleading for a closure notice.

action_items: Remove (or skip duplicating) the auto 'Client comms' note when escalation is undone
Block or warn on Generate when raw logs (and ticket/alert) are empty
Also mask client email domains and contacts when the mask toggle is on
Clear or recompute the Investigation detect hint whenever new logs are applied
Use entry.form.analyst as the author fallback in the Notables statusLog

Optional: subject like '[INFO] Alert Review – NFA' for FP emails; widen the title-number regex (e.g. '5 failed logons' is not caught because a word sits between the number and the keyword); auto-tick the 'Check X in OSINT' checklist item when an OSINT verdict is set
critical_code_review_comments: engine.js numRe /(\d[\d,]*)\s*(connections?|events?|...)/ needs the keyword right after the number; titles like '5 failed logons' are not checked.
App.js keydown effect has no dependency array (it re-subscribes on every render). This works, but a ref-based handler would be cleaner.
Ctrl+Enter on Assessment calls generate() even when focus is in the header analyst input. This is harmless.
Files are small and well split (all under 300 lines), and data-testids are thorough.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested features work; 5 minor bugs, 3 design nits)

seed_data_creation: Test runs created TEST-0001, TEST-0002, TEST-DUP1, TKT-xxxxxx tickets and a 'TEST Client' playbook in browser localStorage only. Each run re-seeded by clearing socdesk.* keys.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only SPA; state lives in localStorage socdesk.*. Clear those keys and reload to re-seed. System clock is Oct 2026, so sample SLA timers show breached (expected). The clipboard API is unavailable headless, so the copy fallback selects text and the button still shows 'Copied'. Notables defaults to the shift of the latest escalation.
